title: helichrysum italicum var. serotinum
intro: Helichrysum italicum var. serotinum, commonly known as the Rock Rose, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family, characterized by its small, yellow daisy-like flowers and silvery-gray leaves. The health benefits of Helichrysum italicum var. serotinum include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and support the immune system. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions, such as arthritis, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Helichrysum italicum var. serotinum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, particularly neryl acetate, which contributes to its medicinal properties.
